headline: Housing & Land Use Committee

meeting.summary: The committee heard testimony on two resolutions to rezone some apartment properties to hotel zoning and recessed to August 19, 2026.
meeting.recap: The Office of Hawaiian Affairs opposed both resolutions, saying they would affect about 498 units.[[1:22:34]] A representative for the Lāhainā property said it burned in a fire and the owners want hotel zoning.[[1:52:14]] A Lāhainā resident opposed both resolutions.[[2:15:15]] The same testifier said FEMA assistance is set to end in early 2027.[[2:20:41]] The same testifier said a temporary housing site in Kīhei would close on the 31st.[[2:21:07]] A council member said their understanding is the site is not closing.[[2:25:35]] The chair recessed the meeting to August 19, 2026, at 9:00 a.m.[[2:26:10]] About a dozen testifiers were still waiting to speak.[[2:26:50]]
decided: The chair recessed the meeting to August 19, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. without a vote on either resolution.
meeting.next: Testimony will continue when the meeting resumes. A council member said the resolutions would go to the planning commission and then come back to the council.

moments.q: "I will be ending this meeting at 11:45."
Attorney raises possible litigation over inconsistent criteria
Office of Hawaiian Affairs testifies in opposition
